balls.text: Boucher misses the high full toss outside off, but the keeper misses it too, and Kolkata will get four off the last ball
superb stuff from Langeveldt, full and wide outside off stump, he tries to reach out for it, but just manages to dig it away close on the off side
well bowled, keeps it on a tight length and he backs away, looking to cut it over point but is beaten by the bounce
goes for the pull of a short of a length ball and sends it to deep midwicket along the ground
gone! high full toss wide outside off, YK tries to launch it over the man at extra cover but he is on the edge of the circle and the flat hit goes straight to him
digs it in short right away, he wasn't expecting it and cannot do anything as it sails over him
cannot get this one away, full delivery and he bashes it away to long on along the ground
digs out a fuller one back to the bowler who lets it slip through and concedes the single
another one, it is Tiwary now, back of a length from Virat at the most gentle pace, and it is swatted in front of deep square leg
fuller delivery slogged down to the man at long on
there goes YK, gentle short of a length ball, YK sets himself up and sends it rocketing over deep midwicket
goes hard at a low and wide full toss and slaps it straight to extra cover
yorker fired in from Gayle, jabbed back to the bowler, good delivery to end the over
that'll do for YK, tossed up, coming down in the slot around off, and YK clobbers it over wide long on
driven wide of long on for a couple of runs
cracked off the front foot from wide outside off, and sweeper cover fields
full toss and he goes hard at it getting it down towards long on
tossed up full outside off, he tries to hit it down the ground but gets inside edge on to pad
steers this one outside off neatly to third man

Pomersbach the prancing panther, comes charging from deep midwicket and goes leaping in the air in the path of another murderous pull from YK, it was a chance if you want to call it that, but only because Pomersbach decided to put himself in the line of fire, got his hands to it but was struck hard on the wrist, saves the boundary in the end
this one will go, another short ball, YK gets in to position very quickly and pulls it powerfully in front of square leg
gets the flick away off the fuller one and deep midwicket is in business again
goes hard at the pull, but mistimes it and the ball loops weakly to fall well short of deep midwicket
walks across and outside off, and flicks it from there to short fine leg
YK gets one away, stands tall and goes hard at a length ball, when he middles them, they generally disappear in to the crowd, as did this one over wide long on

and this is what the stifling stuff is making them do, stands with feet apart outside leg stump looking for the big swing over midwicket, but he follows him with the angle and he manages only a single
can't get this one away as well, they have gone in to a shell, this one is stabbed away to point
now he digs in the bouncer, but overcooks it as it bounces high and wide outside off, Tiwary thinks about the pull but weaves out of the line in the end
this is superb stuff from the Bangalore pace attack, another one rushes on from a length, pegging him on the crease and making him defend on the off side
tries to give him the charge but mistimes the swing off the short ball to mid off
pushed away off the back foot to AB at point, thou shalt not even ponder the thought of a run when the ball has gone to absolutely brilliant
dropped by the bowler, it was a full ball hit hard back to him, came quickly, he got one hand to it, the left, but the ball burst through
Aravind continues to operate close to of stump on a length, played out towards covers

YK could be in trouble, he had rushed across half way for the single as Tiwary pushed another tight delivery to covers, he had to rush back as the throw hit, he is back just in time and they get a run off the ricochet
the brute force of YK comes in to play, smashes a length ball over extra cover but it is cut off by the man sweeping on the boundary
tight stuff from Aravind, this one is pushed out to covers off the front foot
looks to chop this one away casually past point but cannot beat that man
much better, draws him forward with the length ball close to off and he pushes it to point
Mithun overdoes the bouncer, bangs in with those strong shoulders and it goes high and wide outside off
another short of a length ball, YK stands in the crease and pulls it hard wide of deep midwicket who comes to his right to cut it off
this time YK gets it away, stands in the crease, gets not quite on top of this back of a length ball, but with his power, the forcing cut flies over point, third man will fetch the ball
fires in the bouncer and the angle takes it outside off stump and YK cant do anything with it
short of a length and no room to work with he tries to plonk it down on the leg side and run, but Mithun gets to the ball quickly
played out towards extra cover off the back foot
this time he gets a couple with a steer wide of third man
what is it with all these batsmen walking down the surface, Aravind makes him go ducking with a perfectly targetted bouncer
tucked away off the pads for a single to square leg

huge blow, Aravind strikes right away, Gautam looks to force the cut wide of point, but that is where AB is lurking, and he goes screaming to his left to pouch the ball with both hands, that is why they dont have him with the keeping gloves on, what a stunner
gets this one away, no need to charge or waltz or walk or anything, just stays rooted to the crease and bashes it with the angle wide of deep midwicket
again the batsman leaves his crease for the big shot over midwicket but misses the line of the ball completely
tucks him up with the angled ball ending close to off stump, played out to point off the back foot
shuffles across, all the batsmen have been doing that today, and this time he gets the flick backward of square leg for a couple
now has him fending down a short of a length ball that he gets away on the leg side for a run

Zaheer gives the India captain the stare, Gautam cames walking across and down the track, Zaheer pinged in the bouncer and Gautam got out of the way fast, Zaheer likes it, lets Gautam know with the cold stare
again another batsman rushes down the track, can't time the ball as he gets too close to the pitch, and forces it away towards mid off, just manages to get teh single as the throw is a touch wide
takes a step down the track but Zaheer is giving nothing away, on the stumps, on a length, he just dabs it back to the bowler
shuffles and walks a long way outside off stump, and gets hit on the pads and the ball goes behind point

the bouncer has made Kallis try something extra, and has done him in, he backed away a touch outside leg, charged down the track ,eyeing the estra cover boundary, but it was too close to him and he only managed a thick edge to the keeper as he swung hard at it, top stuff from Langeveldt
superb bouncer from Langeveldt, out of nowhere he bangs it and it gets big on Kallis who was surprised and just managed to duck underneath it
has to hurry, pushes a length ball to mid off and takes off for the single, had to really stretch in the end to get to the other end in time
whoops, here comes Gautam in a rush down the track, looking to crash him over midwicket, ball bounces over his bat, and over the stumps
tries to play the forcing drive past the bowler, but bat turns in his hands and the ball goes to mid on
this time he manages to flick it past midwcket for a couple of runs

Kallis almost gets in to trouble here, goes deep in the crease to tonk him over midwicket, the leading edge flies over the off side infield just eluding extra cover, that leading edge, it is so thick one could have walked on that edge without toppling over
hangs back in the crease, similar ball to the one that got Eoin, but Gautam does not commit forward, and tucks it past that man at square leg

that'll do, too much innovation from Eoin, he pays the price, length delivery angled in, he shuffles across, walks down the pitch, gets outside the line to flick it over the leg side but only finds square leg, who does not have to move an inch as he accepts the offering
tries to play that slash-cut again from very close to the body, the length was a bit full too, and he chops it close to the wickets
plants front foot out but Zaheer makes him arrest that movement with a very full length on middle and Eoin has to adjust and pat it back to Zaheer
again Morgan plays that typical forcing slash-cut, this time to a ball on the stumps that bounces and he sends it fine to third man
crouches a bit and stretches to get to this length ball outside off and steers it to third man
this one will go, up and over extra cover, Kallis comes down the track, takes it on the half volley and lofts inside out over the infield
now he comes out and tries to crash it through covers but mistimes it to point
super ball, pitches length outside off, Kallis looks to have a push from the crease, ball leaves him doing that as it moves away
Eoin plays that bent knee, forcing slash-cut of his that sends the ball flying to third man
length ball but cramps him for room around middle, played out to midwicket
even better, Kallis now gets front foot out and just pushes the length ball in the gap past mid off and extra cover, that will be four right away
Kallis responds superbly, walks down the track gets to the pitch of this one going across and eases it through covers, beating the dive from point
length ball this time around off stump played out to covers
even better, the line moves towards from middle from Zaheer, he bolws it even fuller as well, almost in the blockhole, Kallis just about digs it to midwicket
huge appeal first ball, pitches full around leg and comes back in to strike Kaiils on the pads, not given could have been sliding down leg
finally, the game is over, AB latches on to a full ball and clatters it through the gap between extra cover and mid off
oh gosh, another wicket, Tiwary pushes away towards covers and tries to get to the other end, sees the ball overtake him and crash in to the stumps, nothing he could do about it
slants this one wide outside the off stump, gets away with it
Balaji helps bangalore with a high full toss outside leg stump, boucher somehow manages to parry it away with the dive
Tiwary looks to finish it with the slap through covers, backs outside leg and tries to crunch it, but straight to cover
flicked away off the pads backward of square leg
Tiwary is having a tough time, punches wide of point, and struggles across for the single, hobbles, runs a bit, then again hobbles, then stretches in as the throw comes in
tossed up, Tiwary refuses to go for the big one, playing it off the back foot on the leg side
pushed away off the front foot to sweeper cover, and Tiwary hobbles across for the single

that's it, is it, no it is not, he goes down on the knee looking to end the game with the big slog sweep over deep midwicket, did not hit it well enough to beat the fielder there, straight to him, the fireworks have been set off, they had decided it was going to go for six, now what after the match ends?
launches in to the pull off a back of a length ball, goes on the bounce to Morgan at midwicket
gets forward to one going across with the angle and pushes it past extra cover
now he connects with the pull, right off the middle of the bat, hits it so well that deep midwicket does not have to move at all as it comes to him at a nice height
does not get hold of this one, but manages to get the pull past midwicket
that'll do, short delivery, gentle stuff and he rocks back to pull to the midwicket boundary
slanted on a length across the batsman, pushed away off the front foot
133 kph yorker from Bala from wide of the crease, AB digs it away to mid off
very low full toss, reaches out and drives it straight to extra cover without any power
flicked away off the pads to deep square leg
goes for the bouncer and it is called a wide, high and down leg
driven off the front foot but straight to mid off
bowls this one wide off a length
AB gets a single, that's all that is needed now
worked away in front of square leg for a single

gets the outside edge, there is no slip, and he even gets four as the outfield takes over, Iqbal produced the outside edge getting him to come forward, it brushed Boucher's gloves on its way past, a drop, but very tough chance
fuller but outside leg stump and flicked away through square leg
gets forward to push a flatter one to covers
lovely lofted shot, gets inside the line and goes inside out over extra cover
paddles a full one past towards fine leg
stays back to a length ball and tucks it through midwicket
Kaif goes for the big pull from way outside off stump, and gets it over the bowler and past mid off, some way to get off the mark
pegs him on the back foot with a back of a length ball that he defends on the off side

gone! Kallis gets Kohli, lovely delivery, making him push forward with the good length on off stump, and then straightens to take the outside edge for the keeper to take a neat tumbling catch to his right
punches hard off the back foot to sweeper cover
leans in to the extra cover drive, but the man there takes pace off the shot with a dive to his right
length ball straightening on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
punched off the back foot but straight to covers
fuller and slanted in, driven in the air to long on
more short of a length and punched back to the bowler
cut hard and this time he will get four, short and wide, and he fiercely sends the ball wide of a diving point
short of a length and turning away, he punches hard but extra cover dives to save the boundary

AB gets some welcome from Kallis, and returns it back, Kallis gives him a snorter outside off stump, almost takes AB away with it, until he weaves his head away from the ball, Kallis has something to say, AB is not holding back

Unadkat with a leaping screamer of a catch, Pomersbach was eyeing the wide long off boundary, it was the in cutter from Kallis, he half-sliced the big shot, and Unadkat timed the leap at mid off to take a high catch
slam! Pomersbach with the swing, tees off over mid on, takes it from around off stump and bashes it to the boundary
tries the sharp incoming bouncer, he goes for the pull, not in control of the shot, just bounces in front of long leg
length ball on the pads and it is worked away easily in front of square leg
comes on the front foot and flicks a length ball through midwicket
Virat is in no trouble with the short one from Lee, calmly works it away backward of square leg

Lee the athlete does not give up ever, charges to field a delivery fended off the back foot, sees the non-striker backing up too far, picks up the ball, turns around and fires in the direct hit, but they get the overthrow off the ricochet
more short of a length stuff from Lee and it is played out to point again
slants this one across the left-hander from short of a length and he pushes it away towards point
130.2 kph the slower bouncer goes wrong for Lee, goes wide down leg and to the keeper on the bounce
this one is on the pads and he flicks it away through midwicket
crunching stroke, Virat stands tall on the back foot, gets on top of the back of a length ball and leaves sweeper cover stranded with a forcing slap that beats him to the boundary
misfield at mid off, Kolkata will want to forget this match, drives hard to that man and the ball bursts through his hands
cramps him for room with a length ball around leg, he looks to tuck it away but cannot
lunges forward and pushes a length ball in front of cover and pinches the single as the throw comes in
goes for the short ball but slants it wide down leg side
makes him reach out and drive this length ball, in the air for a while before it falls well short of extra cover
looks to force it off the back foot through extra cover but cannot time it at all
gentle fuller one from Kallis outside off, eased away to point off the front foot, feels other worldly to see someone ease the ball
wants to forcefully pull another short one but cannot connect this time and takes it on the body
the runs continue to flow, gets on top of the short ball and pulls it away through square leg, excellent diving stop on the boundary by YK

and gets his man finally, the angles does it, Gayle looked to slog it over midwicket, from the crease, another outside edge, goes in to the stratosphere, Kallis settles under it on the ground, and takes it cleanly as the missile comes down
take that, Gayle's brand of non-violence, 145 kph full ball, Gayle takes a step out, shows the full face of a straight bat, one bounce in to the straight boundary, cruel
full ball eased back down the track, Lee cannot stop it, they steal the single as mid on comes charging in
Lee beats the bat, but no edge, slanted full across off, he reaches out for the drive and is beaten

make way, here comes another one, oh this must be depressing for the opposition, short of a length, Gayle backs away, and carts it over extra cover, who tried to leap and get to it, the ball had almost reached the boundary by the time he got in the air
backs away and goes over extra cover, but ends up mishitting it, Morgan pulls it back in with the dive close to the ropes
Gayle has the orange cap, in his seventh game, full delivery, in the slot, under the bat, in to the crowd miles over long on, smoked

well, well, when the elements have conspired against you, then the Gayle storm hits you, no luck for Kolkata, Gayle throws his bat at one outside off and the outside edge goes over the third man boundary
another back of a length ball, but this one angles in close to off, he tries to leave it late but the ball takes the edge to go towards third man, nothing going Kolkata's way
gentle back of a length ball wide outside off, he gets on his toes and cuts in to the gap at covers, Bangalore are racing away with this at the moment
can't get a pacy full toss away this time, tries to slog it through midwicket but it goes to YK at square leg
no justice for Lee, the full delivery around off, Gayle gives it a good thump and the ball disappears in to the deep cover boundary

no luck for Lee, Gayle had got a four off an outside edge, now he gets four with a top edge, Lee with the pacy bouncer, Gayle is in no position to play the pull and gets a top edge that flies over fine leg, Boucher goes charging after it but it trickles in to the boundary
super comeback from Brett Lee, at 141 kph he fires in the perfect yorker, Gayle does well to get legs out of the way, and jam down on it in time
crack! this one pitches full and Gayle gives it a firm forward push, and the ball rocks over cover and in to the boundary
low full toss outside off, Gayle goes feeling for it, and the thick edge flies wide of the lone slip
